term: same selected necessary root with esse maximality and perfection
definition: There exists ONE witness n that is an actual concrete root of the selected grounding relation at w, necessary at accessible worlds, equal to every other selected actual root, maximal in the supplied esse respect, and universally perfect in the existing formal-or-eminent InAct sense. This concerns selected actual roots, not uniqueness of all necessary individuals or rootness in every world. InAct and MoreIn are supplied global dictionaries; their world correspondence, formal-or-eminent meaning and comparison interpretation remain OPEN. GoodIn and CausesIn do not occur in this conclusion predicate. No God predicate, naming, moral perfection, omniscience, explanatory sufficiency or philosophical premise truth is established.
note: Packages existing ActualRoot, NecessaryAt, selected root uniqueness, IsMaximumIn, IsPerfect with a shared existential witness. No new attribute semantics or source reading. Dependencies: DEF-ACTUAL-ROOT (including the guarded concrete/present source edge), DEF-KANT-MODAL-NECESSITY (the same individual at accessible worlds), DEF-MAXIME-ENS (merely maximal at the supplied esse), DEF-UNIVERSALLY-PERFECT (∀ x r, InAct x r → InAct n r), DEF-ACT, DEF-ESSE and DEF-MORE-IN. The carrier B, world/frame and Profile predicates, respect carrier R, esse value and InAct/MoreIn dictionaries remain explicit parameters. Their semantic applicability is OPEN; the package imposes no order laws or moral interpretation.
